name: key-club-hour-implementation
description:
This is a tool meant to assist (Key Club) secretaries automate the manual process of inputing data into a large membership database table.
In greater depth, the Key Club Hour Automator (which will be refered to as KcHA from this point forward) takes several lists divided by member position (officer/member) then grade level provided in an officer restricted Google Sheet, then searches several sheets organized by member position (officer/member) then grade level in a seperate public Google Sheet for tracking membership hours, finally a new column is made on each sheet inside the public Google Sheet and for each name found on both Google Sheets is given hours based on the private Google Sheet.
author: Cody
